== Build notes: original card source (6 November 2026) ==
Added [https://web.archive.org/web/20020612231318/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/small/r5d4.html R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)] explicitly as the original printed-face source. Existing glossary, card-list, and other sources are retained. The original printed face has no [[Nav Computer]] icon. The retained nav computer capability is rule-derived: the [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Decipher Glossary], pp. 15 and 94, states that astromechs function as nav computers. The icon field is unchanged; how to distinguish printed icons from this rule-derived capability in the template remains unresolved. No card data, images, IDs, or version labels were changed.
